requirements.function: emergency stop removes torque from both wheels through the power-removal inputs of the two drives
requirements.trigger: emergency stop button, two normally closed channels, through a safety relay

documents.title: BLV Series R Type Operating Manual, Installation and Connection Edition (HP-5140-8E)

requirements.notes: The drive manual asks for a risk assessment and a verification test of the power-removal function (HP-5140-8E p.7). No certificate for BLVD-KRD is pinned and no risk assessment exists. A person responsible for safety must complete this register.

requirements.function: emergency stop opens the drive supply through a contactor, because the ZLAC8015D has no torque-off input
requirements.trigger: emergency stop button, two normally closed channels, through a safety relay and a contactor
requirements.notes: Opening the supply of a drive that regenerates needs a bleeder resistor (ZLAC8015D manual 3.6). No document supports the contactor arrangement yet; it is a question for the hardware lead.
